# Business Central Launch Event - 2026 release wave 2

> Unofficial, LLM-navigable index of the 38 launch event videos (7h09) that Microsoft published on 2026-10-01 for Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 2. Built from YouTube auto-captions; every claim links to a video and a second. Made by waldo (Eric Wauters), not by Microsoft.

Start with AGENTS.md, then data/index/features.json for structured answers or data/features/<slug>.md for prose. Per-video pages are in data/videos/<id>.md. Full transcripts (private build only) are in data/transcripts/full/<id>.md.

## Core files (raw GitHub URLs)

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/AGENTS.md): how to navigate and cite this repository, file schemas, example questions
- [features.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/index/features.json): the merged feature graph (319 features, status, airtime, videos, quotes, docs match)
- [videos.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/videos.json): the 38 videos with ids, titles, lengths
- [airtime.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/index/airtime.json): seconds per area, feature, status, audience
- [gap-analysis.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/index/gap-analysis.json): documented features vs what the videos covered
- [timelines.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/index/timelines.json): per video chapters, demo ranges, disclaimer moments
- [wordcount.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/index/wordcount.json): buzzword counts

- [Finance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/areas/finance.md): 18 features, 19 min of video

- [Admin and platform](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/areas/admin-and-platform.md): 36 features, 36 min of video
- [Integration (Fabric, Shopify, MDM)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/areas/integration.md): 39 features, 57 min of video

## Reports

- [Developer digest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/reports/dev-digest.md): the 108 minutes that matter to AL developers, deep-linked
- [What they didn't say](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/reports/what-they-didnt-say.md): documented but not shown, shown but not documented, status conflicts
- [Buzzword bingo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/data/reports/buzzword-bingo.md): counts per video and total
- [llms-full.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/waldo1001/msdyn365-2026-release-wave-2/main/llms-full.txt): all feature pages and video pages concatenated (no raw transcripts)
